diagnostics.message: google_compute_project_default_network_tier.default_network_tier calls the Compute Engine API, but it can run before google_project_service.project_services enables compute.googleapis.com. Order the network-tier update after API enablement.

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service waits for perimeter membership but not google_project_service.project_services. When the module enables compute.googleapis.com, service-project attachment can race that activation.

google_logging_metric.metrics requires the Logging API, but has no ordering dependency on google_project_service.project_services. Creating metrics can race activation of logging.googleapis.com managed by this module.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion requires the Logging API but does not wait for google_project_service.project_services. Exclusion creation can race logging.googleapis.com enablement.

google_logging_log_scope.log-scopes uses the Logging API without waiting for google_project_service.project_services. When logging.googleapis.com is enabled in the same apply, log-scope creation can run too early.

google_monitoring_notification_channel.channels requires the Monitoring API but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. Channel creation can race monitoring.googleapis.com activation.

google_monitoring_alert_policy.alerts requires the Monitoring API, but neither it nor its notification-channel dependency currently waits for google_project_service.project_services. Alert-policy creation can race monitoring.googleapis.com enablement.

google_project_iam_binding.authoritative resolves $service_agents aliases to synthesized email strings. Waiting for API enablement does not order it after google_project_service_identity.default generates those identities; bindings using newly generated agents can fail because the principal does not exist yet.

google_project_iam_binding.bindings resolves $service_agents aliases from constructed emails, not google_project_service_identity.default attributes. Bindings for newly generated service agents can run before identity creation completes.

google_project_iam_member.bindings can select a $service_agents principal through local.ctx_iam_principals, whose email is synthesized. It should wait for google_project_service_identity.default when granting roles to agents generated in the same apply.

google_project_iam_binding.authoritative can grant roles to the synthesized Cloud Storage service-agent alias without waiting for data.google_storage_project_service_account.gcs_sa. The data lookup ensures that this lazily created account exists; API activation alone is insufficient.

google_project_iam_binding.bindings can resolve a Cloud Storage service-agent alias to a constructed email. It should wait for data.google_storage_project_service_account.gcs_sa to ensure the lazily created principal exists before applying that binding.

google_project_iam_member.bindings can use a synthesized Cloud Storage service-agent email, but does not wait for data.google_storage_project_service_account.gcs_sa to materialize the account. Such grants can fail on a fresh project.

google_project_iam_binding.authoritative can select the BigQuery encryption service-account alias, whose email is constructed rather than read from data.google_bigquery_default_service_account.bq_sa. Order those grants after the lookup that obtains the account, as already done for CMEK grants.

google_project_iam_binding.bindings can grant roles to the synthesized BigQuery encryption service-account alias without waiting for data.google_bigquery_default_service_account.bq_sa. The grant can race first-time account provisioning.

google_project_iam_member.bindings resolves service-agent aliases without referencing data.google_bigquery_default_service_account.bq_sa. Grants selecting the BigQuery encryption account should wait for this lookup rather than racing account provisioning.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek already waits for google_project_service.project_services through google_project_iam_member.service_agents, google_project_service_identity.default, and the service-account data sources. Its direct depends_on entry adds no ordering.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek already depends on google_project_iam_member.service_agents, which explicitly depends on google_project_service_identity.default. The direct identity dependency duplicates that path.

google_project_iam_member.service_agents already depends on google_project_service_identity.default, which depends on google_project_service.project_services. Its direct API-enablement dependency is transitive and redundant.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already waits for google_project_service.project_services through its identity, default-service-account, and service-account data-source dependencies. The direct entry duplicates those paths.

google_compute_subnetwork_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already waits for google_project_service.project_services through its identity, default-service-account, and service-account data-source dependencies. Its direct depends_on entry is redundant.

google_logging_project_sink.sink depends on the three project IAM binding/member resources, each of which already depends on google_project_service.project_services. The sink's direct API-enablement dependency duplicates those paths.

output.id depends on google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.service_projects, which already depends on google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host. The direct host dependency is redundant.
output.id already waits for google_org_policy_policy.default through google_project_service.project_services and its downstream resources. Its direct organization-policy dependency adds no ordering.

output.id depends on resources such as google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek and the Shared VPC host configuration that already wait for google_project_service.project_services. Its direct service dependency is redundant.

output.id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which already depends on google_project_iam_member.service_agents. The direct service-agent IAM dependency duplicates that ordering.

output.id already waits for google_project_service_identity.default through google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek and google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots. Its direct identity dependency is redundant.
output.id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which explicitly waits for google_project.project. The output's direct project dependency duplicates that path.
output.id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which explicitly waits for data.google_project.project. The direct data-source dependency is redundant.

output.project_id depends on google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.service_projects, which already waits for google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host. Its direct host dependency is redundant.

output.project_id already waits for google_org_policy_policy.default through google_project_service.project_services and the other initialization resources. Its direct organization-policy entry is redundant.

output.project_id depends on initialization resources that already wait for google_project_service.project_services, including the CMEK grants and Shared VPC host configuration. Its direct service dependency adds no ordering.
output.project_id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which already waits for google_project_iam_member.service_agents. The direct service-agent IAM entry is redundant.
output.project_id already waits for google_project_service_identity.default through its CMEK and Shared VPC service-agent IAM dependencies. The direct identity dependency duplicates those paths.
output.project_id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which explicitly depends on google_project.project. Its direct project dependency is redundant.
output.project_id depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which explicitly depends on data.google_project.project. Its direct project-data-source entry is redundant.

output.number depends on google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.service_projects, which already waits for google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host. The direct host dependency duplicates that ordering.

output.number already waits for google_org_policy_policy.default through google_project_service.project_services and the downstream initialization resources. Its direct organization-policy entry is redundant.

output.number depends on initialization resources that already wait for google_project_service.project_services, including the CMEK grants and Shared VPC configuration. Its direct service dependency is redundant.
output.number depends on google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek, which already depends on google_project_iam_member.service_agents. Its direct service-agent IAM dependency is redundant.
output.number already waits for google_project_service_identity.default through its CMEK and Shared VPC service-agent IAM dependencies. Its direct identity dependency duplicates those paths.

output.name already waits for google_org_policy_policy.default through google_project_service.project_services and the downstream resources in its depends_on list. The direct organization-policy entry is redundant.

output.name depends on the CMEK grants, Shared VPC service projects, and Shared VPC service-agent IAM grants, which already wait for google_project_service.project_services. Its direct service dependency is redundant.

output.service_agents depends on google_project_iam_member.service_agents, which already explicitly waits for google_project_service_identity.default. The output's direct identity dependency adds no ordering.
output.services depends on google_project_service_identity.default, which already waits for google_project_service.project_services. Its direct service-enablement dependency is redundant.
